messages:
lee patel: Vendor (Acme Sec) asked for a 3-day engagement window. They want RBAC mapping, KMS grant method, and a copy of pre-window audit exports. Can we outline handoff steps?

kevin ramos: I can handle RBAC. My plan: create fine-grained 'pen_test_assessor_v2' role, attach resource ARNs for only inference APIs and model stores. No wildcards.

olivia hart: For logs: we'll snapshot CloudTrail + app request logs. I'll create an immutable copy to a locked bucket and provide a presigned download for assessors.

vendor-acme: FYI we will run authenticated fuzzing + some high-RPS replay of sample prompts. Need a service account or role to assume. No access to secrets required.

kevin ramos: Good. We'll provide assume-role with MFA enforced and a short session duration (1h). Also restrict source IP ranges to the vendor's egress CIDR.

devops-bot: maintenance: pausing auto-deploys for window 2026-04-12 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-14 23:59 UTC. Confirm chord.

lee patel: Retest criteria suggestion: fix merged + staging rollout + curated reproduce steps + evidence bundle (CloudTrail, SIEM queries) showing no exploit patterns for enumerated CVEs. Vendor must submit PoV within 48h of window end.

olivia hart: Audit export commands I'll provide: `aws s3 sync s3://cloudtrail-prod/2026/04/ /tmp/ct-snap/ --exclude "*partial*"` then `tar -czf ct-snap-2026-04-12.tar.gz /tmp/ct-snap/` and upload to presigned path.

kevin ramos: KMS grant pattern (CLI draft):

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-pen-test --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen_test_assessor_v2 --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pen-test"} --retiring-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/key-admin
```

We'll schedule grant retirement for +96h.

vendor-acme: Can you also provide a replay user that can only call inference:Invoke and read back sanitized responses? We don't need raw secret values.

kevin ramos: Yes. We'll create a scoped policy: `inference:Invoke*` on ARN:/service/inference/*/models/model-*/invoke and deny logs/list secrets.

olivia hart: For extra assurance I'll trigger an immediate SIEM baseline report: count of anomalous auth attempts and high-rate inference calls in the 72h pre-window. Share in tracker.

audit-bot: Created pen-test ticket: https://go/internal/pen-tests/1751230001. Checklist items added: RBAC mapping, KMS grant, audit snapshot, presigned upload URL, change-freeze confirmation.

lee patel: Action owners: kevin = RBAC + role creation; olivia = audit snapshots + SIEM baseline; kevin and ops = KMS grant flow; lee = vendor coordination + retest scheduling. Please add ETA to tracker by COB Tuesday.

kevin ramos: I'll open a draft infra PR with IAM and grant snippet. ETA Tue AM.

olivia hart: I'll place export scripts and retention policy (365d) in the secure tracker doc and add commands for cross-account copy.

vendor-acme: Thanks, team. We'll submit our attack plan tomorrow and list IP ranges. Expect a short smoke run first day.

lee patel: Noted. Also: no emergency hotfixes during window unless security-critical and agreed by @lee patel + @kevin ramos. We'll keep an on-call rotation for quick approvals.

kevin ramos: I'll put the assume-role ARN + trust policy in the PR and include example `aws sts assume-role` command for the vendor.

olivia hart: Final note: require evidence upload to presigned S3 path with server-side encryption and enforced object-lock retention. I'll coordinate with SRE.

lee patel: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping here or update the ticket. We'll confirm final scope after vendor sends IP list.
